analyst.summary: SML Isuzu makes light and medium commercial vehicles and buses as a joint venture backed by Sumitomo and Isuzu. Unit sales have been growing at a modest pace, but profitability has been thin. The company has just approved a large acquisition of Mahindra & Mahindra's truck and bus manufacturing business, a deal that would meaningfully change the size and shape of the business — this is a genuinely important pending development that isn't yet reflected in the standard financial scorecard, so we are flagging it for a closer look before forming a firmer view.
